title: Bracket closing learned in six examples from a supplied rule shape
summary: A counter-and-buffer reader handles strings, pairs and brackets. For brackets the learning step receives the shape of the target rule: the next closer is determined by the opener of the innermost unmatched bracket. With the shape given, six example words are enough to fix the two-entry output map.
core_idea: Give the learner the rule shape 'answer from the innermost unmatched opener', so nesting is learned from six examples.

state.name: buf
state.meaning: Buffer of C symbols; strings are written in order, openers at the current depth; C = 64.

state.name: pr
state.meaning: Pair rows for pair tasks: (first symbol, partner).

state.name: Gamma
state.meaning: Supplied rule shape: the output is a function of the innermost unmatched opener, read off the prefix.

state.name: omega
state.meaning: Two-entry output map from opener type to closer, learned.

update.latex: x_t \text{ opener}: dd \leftarrow dd+1,\, buf_{dd} \leftarrow x_t;\quad x_t \text{ closer}: dd \leftarrow dd - 1
update.plain: openers are pushed at the new depth, closers pop and lower the depth
update.name: depth

update.plain: pair tasks write each completed pair as a row
update.name: pairs

readout.plain: bracket output: omega of the innermost unmatched opener given by the supplied shape; pair probes read the partner stored with x_t; strings read buf in order

learning.description: With Gamma supplied, omega is the majority closer per opener type, by count over the m training words. Pair and string routing are chosen by accuracy on the training items.
learning.few_shot_argument: Gamma removes the search over rules; omega has two entries, so m = 6 words at depth 2 suffice on every seed.

complexity.constants_notes: Buffer and row writes O(1); pair reads scan C rows; 3C + 4 words.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: The supplied rule shape leaves a two-entry map.

prediction.statement: From m = 6 bracket words of depth 2, the learned reader predicts the legal closer with accuracy at least 0.99 on three seeds.

capabilities.prediction: Learned at depth 2 from m = 6; exact at depth 2, 4, 8, 16 with C = 64.
Exact at K = 8, 32, 64 and L = 8, 32, 64 with C = 64.
Exact at T = 4, 16, 32 and hops 1, 4, 8 by chained row reads.
Depth beyond C cannot be tracked: at C = 64 a word that opens 65 brackets before closing loses the outermost opener.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: 6 training words of depth 2 after which closer accuracy is below 0.99.
A depth-16 word whose closer the hand-set buffer predicts wrongly.

toy_example.description: The supplied shape on a depth-2 word, with omega learned from it.
